subject.title: Conversational agent lane wedges indefinitely: ingress events never reconcile (re-delivery storm on reconnect) + abort_embedded_run leaves owner lock unreleased (released=0)

question: Should maintainers land the open bounded durable replay PR as the canonical fix for the remaining WhatsApp ingress replay storm, including its public durable-replay SDK surface and five-attempt dead-letter policy?
rationale: Current main fixes the lane-owner half, but the remaining behavior requires choosing a message-delivery and Plugin SDK contract rather than a purely mechanical source repair.

options.title: Accept the open PR direction
options.body: Land the bounded replay/dead-letter approach after normal exact-head review and use it as the canonical fix for this issue.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Ask the PR to keep replay helpers internal or change the cap/dead-letter policy before it becomes the issue-closing path.

options.title: Split operator tooling
options.body: Close the replay-storm bug after the code fix and track drain/ack CLI support as a separate maintainer-owned feature.

recommendation.title: Accept the open PR direction
recommendation.body: Land the bounded replay/dead-letter approach after normal exact-head review and use it as the canonical fix for this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is channel/message-delivery and Plugin SDK surface policy, and recent related PR discussion already requested this owner for that area.
